title: Cozy skiing game
author: bitwisegaminghq
selftext:
Modelled my skiing game on the Crystal mountain in Washington state.

One mountain. Plenty of ways down.

Ski or snowboard through 70 trails and park routes, link tricks into combos, or cruise at your own pace in Free Ride. For a little extra chaos, try outrunning bears and yetis in Endless Survival.

Customize your rider, chase achievements and leaderboard records, and share the slopes with friends or AI riders.

It’s a playful mountain experiment, and I’d love to hear what you think. Pick a line, take a run—and yes, you can be a chicken.

comments.author: SpicyBoyEnthusiast
comments.body: Crystal mountain was the first place I went snowboarding! Cool
